page_title: BOC 1-1 UNI | Bochum v Union Berlin 27/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Deniz Aytekin is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
90+6' The referee allows time for a substitution. Andrej Ilic will be replaced by Marin Ljubicic (Union Berlin).
90+5' Steffen Baumgart has decided to make a change. David Preu (Union Berlin) replaces Andras Schafer.
90+5' Matus Bero (Bochum) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
90+3' Myron Boadu (Bochum) was probably a bit loose with his words to Deniz Aytekin, who decides to show him a yellow.
90+3' Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle and it's Georgios Masouras (Bochum) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Union Berlin have been awarded a free kick.
90+1' Matus Bero (Bochum) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
90' We will have 10 min. of added time.
89' It looks like Bernardo (Bochum) saw red with that tackle. Deniz Aytekin won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Union Berlin will take a free kick near the side line.
86' Myron Boadu (Bochum) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
85' A cross from Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
84' Substitution. Benedict Hollerbach is replaced by Tim Skarke (Union Berlin).
84' Steffen Baumgart decides to make a substitution. Janik Haberer will be replaced by Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin).
83' Bernardo (Bochum) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
80' Dieter Hecking has decided to substitute Tim Oermann and he is replaced by Felix Passlack (Bochum).
80' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

78' Great chance! Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) picks up a rebound inside the box, cuts inside his marker but rifles his shot high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
78' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
76' A pass from Tim Oermann (Bochum) is intercepted by Frederik Ronnow and the move breaks down.
76' The attendance for today's match is 26000.
75' Matus Bero (Bochum) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
74' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Bochum will take a corner kick.
72' Myron Boadu (Bochum) is adjudged offside.
71' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) sends a cross into the box, but Timo Horn comes off his line to gather the ball.
68' 1 - 1 Goal! Matus Bero (Bochum) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 1:1.

68' Matus Bero (Bochum) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it low towards the middle of the target. His effort isn't powerful nor precise enough, allowing Frederik Ronnow to keep the ball out of the net.
68' Matus Bero (Bochum) is going to take the penalty!
68' Deniz Aytekin sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!

68' Play continues despite the shouts by some Bochum players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Deniz Aytekin interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
67' PENALTY APPEAL by Bochum, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
66' Dangerous play by Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin). Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul. Bochum are awarded a free kick.
64' Steffen Baumgart is forced to make a change. Diogo Leite is unable to continue due to injury, Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) comes on.
61' The substitution is prepared. Gerrit Holtmann joins the action as a substitute, replacing Moritz Broschinski (Bochum).
61' Here's the change. Philipp Hofmann leaves the pitch and Dani de Wit (Bochum) comes on as a substitute.
57' The game is interrupted now, Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
57' Tom Krauss (Bochum) gets to a rebound on the edge of the box and strikes, but he only hits the right post and wastes a promising chance!
55' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) commits a foul and Deniz Aytekin immediately signals a free kick. A free kick has been awarded to Union Berlin.
55' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
55' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Bochum have been awarded a corner kick.
54' Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul after Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Bochum are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
51' Today's referee Deniz Aytekin rightly decides to book Matus Bero (Bochum) for his harsh tackle.

50' A great pass puts Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.

47' The free kick evades the keeper and presents Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) with an almost open goal, but he somehow heads high over the bar from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
46' Jakov Medic (Bochum) commits a rough challenge and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul. Union Berlin have a free kick.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Dieter Hecking gives a chance to Georgios Masouras (Bochum) and Cristian Gamboa is off.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bochum.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
42' It seemed like Matus Bero (Bochum) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
41' Deniz Aytekin shows a yellow card to Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
40' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul. Bochum are awarded the free kick.
38' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
38' Deniz Aytekin couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Matus Bero (Bochum) and blew his whistle. That's a free kick to Union Berlin.
37' Flag up against Myron Boadu (Bochum). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
36' Deniz Aytekin shows a yellow card to Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) for a tough tackle.

36' Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Free kick. Union Berlin will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
35' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul. Bochum earn a free kick.

34' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
33' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
33' A player from Bochum commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. Union Berlin have a free kick.
33' Bochum have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
32' Jakov Medic (Bochum) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. Bochum have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
32' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) serves up a nice cross, but Frederik Ronnow punches the ball away.
31' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
31' Bochum are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
28' Bochum failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
27' Matus Bero (Bochum) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Bochum will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
26' Myron Boadu (Bochum) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Union Berlin, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
25' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Deniz Aytekin saw the whole situation. There is a free kick near the sideline to Union Berlin.
24' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
23' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
20' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) says something out of turn to the referee and is shown a yellow card.
20' Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle and signals a foul after Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) brought his opponent down. Bochum will take a free kick.
17' 0 - 1 Goal! Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) gets a shot away from inside the box and the effort is deflected past the goalkeeper. 0:1.
17' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

17' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Union Berlin will have a chance to score from a corner.
14' Bochum are ruled offside.
12' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
10' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

10' The rebound finds Tom Krauss (Bochum) in space inside the box, but his shot goes well wide of the left post. That was a promising chance! The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
8' Half-chance! Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) plays a pass into the box, but Timo Horn reacts well to snuff out the attack.
8' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) whips in a cross from the corner, but Frederik Ronnow is well positioned and punches the ball away.
7' Wow, what an escape. Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bochum.
6' Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
6' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
6' Tom Krauss (Bochum) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Good work from Bochum as they win a corner.
6' Matus Bero (Bochum) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
4' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Timo Horn intercepts the ball.
3' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Bochum, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
2' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) was too forceful with his tackle and Deniz Aytekin interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A free kick is awarded to Union Berlin.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Union Berlin will have the kick-off.
Deniz Aytekin will supervise the game today.
